title: AION 2 Tier List: Global and KR/TW Comparisons
description: Compare CrusherXGaming and Wiggles' AION 2 class tiers, including Spiritmaster's S+ versus D split, with region, sample, and gameplay context.
summary: Two named authors disagree sharply on Spiritmaster and Ranger. Compare their tiers and methods, then choose for solo play, group PvE, or PvP.
quickAnswer: There is no verified universal Global class ranking here: CrusherXGaming rates Spiritmaster S+, while Wiggles rates it D in a different KR/TW PvE comparison. Use the two attributed lists to shortlist a class for your activity, then compare its role and playstyle.

topic.alt: Official AION 2 artwork of the Spiritmaster class
topic.caption: Official Spiritmaster class artwork, shown beside the S+/D disagreement. It depicts the class identity, not tested Global strength.

workflow.title: Turn the two rankings into a class decision
workflow.caption: Keep the activity and evidence behind each rating visible; do not average the letters into a new Global score.

steps.label: Name the activity
steps.description: Write down solo exploration, organized PvE, or PvP before choosing a rating to rely on.

steps.label: Use the relevant comparison
steps.description: CrusherXGaming mixes launch comfort and group utility; Wiggles considers KR/TW PvE leaderboard representation.

steps.label: Inspect the large split
steps.description: Spiritmaster S+/D and Ranger B/S call for checking progression and gameplay, not declaring a universal winner.

steps.label: Test your actual character
steps.description: Use comparable encounters and note uptime, recovery, mechanics, and missing options before rerolling.
